wargear.name: Baronial heraldry
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hundred years of victories painted across the faceplate and shoulder carapace, each one a promise to the Household. The Knight fights with the whole court watching and gains +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Ballistic Skill.

wargear.name: Sacristan's reliquary
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A locked casket of sacred oils, coolant-psalters and the ashes of former pilots, kept by a Sacristan who rides in the lee of the war machine. The Knight gains +1 Hull Point (or +1 Wound on an Armiger).

wargear.name: Heraldic Warhorn
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hunting horn of silvered brass the length of a man, sounded from a Knight's shoulder to send the Household's levies forward.

wargear.name: Ablative Mantle
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Layered ceramite shingles hung over the carapace, built to burn away in place of the frame beneath.

wargear.name: Gunnery Cantor
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hooded cogitator-savant who chants firing solutions into the Knight's ear.

wargear.name: Oathmarker Beacon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A standard-staff driven into the earth to mark ground the Household has sworn not to give up.

wargear.name: Honour-scourge
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A braided lash carried by the sergeant, for use on laggards and on those who flinch.

wargear.name: Barony Signal Rockets
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bandolier of coloured flares that tells the great engines where the Baron wants them to look.

wargear.name: Furrow-plough
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A broad blade slung beneath the prow to clear hedgerows, wreckage and, if need be, men.

modifiers.text: Pressed levies who know the Household's justice: +1 LD, -1 CL.

rules.name: Scions Ahead of the Baron
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Armiger Ward). Before the first battle turn, after both sides have deployed, a model with this rule may make a free move of up to 6". It can't end that move within 12" of an enemy model.

rules.name: Declared Challenge
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Lists of Honour). A model with this rule adds 1 to its Charge roll against an enemy Knight, Titan or Walker. If it can charge one of those, it must charge one rather than any other target.

rules.name: Ledger of Vows
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Sacristan's Vigil). Once per battle, a model with this rule may add 1 to one Auto-Repair roll.

rules.name: Sworn to the Baron
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Muster of the Free Levy). A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Cool for Morale and Cool Checks while within 12" of a friendly Knight or Armiger.

rules.name: Herald's Summons
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, in its controlling player's Movement phase, the bearer may sound the horn. Until the end of that turn every friendly unit within 12" adds 2" to its Rush distance.

rules.name: Ablative Sacrifice
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The first Hull Point (or Wound, on an Armiger) the bearer would lose to a Shooting Attack each battle is ignored.

rules.name: Cantor's Lock
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once in each of its controlling player's Shooting phases, one ranged weapon of the bearer adds 1 to its Hit Tests.

rules.name: Oathkeeper
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While within 6" of an objective, the bearer counts as having Line (1). It may not Rush in a turn in which it starts within 6" of an objective it wishes to keep.

rules.name: Drill Discipline
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While the Sergeant lives, the unit adds 1 to its Cool for Morale Checks. A unit that nevertheless fails a Morale Check removes one model other than the Sergeant as a casualty.

rules.name: Signal Flare
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, in its controlling player's Shooting phase, one friendly Knight or Armiger within 24" of the bearer adds 1 to the Hit Tests of one Shooting Attack against a target the bearer's unit can see.

rules.name: Furrow-Plough
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The vehicle ignores Dangerous Terrain Tests. It loses 1 Movement.

armyRules.name: Liege-Sworn Retinue
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Household's levies fight better under the Baron's eye and worse without it. A Militia or Auxilia unit within 12" of a friendly Knight or Armiger adds 1 to its Cool for Morale Checks. When a friendly Knight is destroyed, every such unit within 12" of it must make a Cool Check or gain the Suppressed Status.

armyRules.name: Heraldic Pride
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A Knight cannot let an insult to its colours pass. A Knight with this rule gains +1 Weapon Skill. If an enemy Knight, Titan or Walker is within the Knight's charge reach and visible, the Knight must declare a Charge against it or make a Cool Check; on a failure it gains the Suppressed Status.

armyRules.name: Ward of the Elders
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Armigers are the Household's heirs and the Knights guard them jealously. An Armiger within 6" of a friendly Knight ignores the Pinned and Suppressed Statuses. If no friendly Knight is left on the battlefield, the Armiger is cut adrift and loses 2 Leadership and 2 Cool.
armyRules.condition: when no friendly Knight is on the battlefield

rites.name: The Armiger Ward
rites.flavor: The young scions go first, and the Baron watches from the ridge.
benefits: Armiger Helverins, Warglaives and Moiraxes may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Armigers gain Scions Ahead of the Baron: after both sides deploy and before the first turn, each may make a free move of up to 6".
limitations: At least three Armigers are required.
No Acastus Knights, and no more than one Lord of War.
Every Lord of War must start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Armiger Ward: Line (1), Scions Ahead of the Baron.

rites.name: The Lists of Honour
rites.flavor: A Knight who will not name his challenge is only a tank with a coat of arms.
benefits: Every Knight gains Fear (1), +1 Weapon Skill and Declared Challenge: it adds 1 to its Charge rolls against an enemy Knight, Titan or Walker.
limitations: At least one Knight is required.
No Recon, no Support and no Acastus Knights.
A Knight that can charge an enemy Knight, Titan or Walker must do so rather than charge anything else.

modifiers.text: The Lists of Honour: Fear (1), +1 WS, Declared Challenge.

require.note: A Knight must issue the challenge.

rites.name: The Sacristan's Vigil
rites.flavor: Each Knight is carried to war on a ledger of vows, and the ledger is long.
benefits: Every Knight gains +2 Hull Points and Ledger of Vows: once per battle it may add 1 to one Auto-Repair roll.
limitations: No more than two Lords of War.

modifiers.text: The Sacristan's Vigil: +2 HP, -2 M, Ledger of Vows.

rites.name: Muster of the Free Levy
rites.flavor: The Baron calls his tithe, and every town on his world sends its sons.
benefits: Grenadier Troops may fill Troops slots; Grenadier and Levy Troops gain Line (1).
Militia gain Sworn to the Baron: Morale and Cool Checks made within 12" of a friendly Knight or Armiger gain +1 Cool.
limitations: At least two Infantry Troops are required.
No more than one Lord of War, and no Armiger Moirax.

modifiers.text: Muster of the Free Levy: Line (1).
Muster of the Free Levy: Sworn to the Baron.

require.note: Bring at least two Infantry Troops.
